integrity: All-length proof with explicit kernel and probability asymptotic; independently implemented exhaustive, transfer and local max-plus finite checks; finite experiments not treated as proof of infinite statements; not independently audited.
scientific_limitations: Only finite open paths and three-state threshold-one synchronous Greenberg–Hastings excitation are treated. The sequence A025565 and its square-root generating function existed already as combinatorial objects; claimed originality is their exact longest-extinction dynamical interpretation and probability. Equivalent unindexed historical work cannot be excluded.
title: A square-root law for maximal extinction times in three-state excitation on finite paths
